mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls > 10% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in personal savings (RSAFS) exceeding 5% signals reduced household liquidity, which reduces consumer spending and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
